headings.instruction: Never use Inter for headings. Use tight tracking for headers.

data_metrics.instruction: Use monospace for all live numerical data, KPIs, and table metrics to ensure alignment and tech-forward feel.

colors.instruction: Strict monochrome structural base tinted slightly blue. Colors are used PURELY for data state (signal red for errors, electric green for active connections, yellow for warnings).

layout.grid_strategy: MODE B: THE CONTROL ROOM GRID
rules: Every pixel must be utilized. Use h-full on children.
Density is key. No loose whitespace in the operations center.
Asymmetry is allowed in widget widths (col-span-2 vs col-span-1).

surfaces.header_classes: border-b border-white/10 bg-[#050505]/90 backdrop-blur-md sticky top-0 z-50
surfaces.instruction: Avoid soft shadows. Use sharp 1px borders. Apply 'The Technical Look' where adjacent borders overlap perfectly.

kpi_cards.content: Top left label (uppercase, wide tracking), bottom left massive number (JetBrains Mono text-4xl), right side mini sparkline.

charts.style: Lines must be 2px thick. Area charts should use strong gradient fades to transparent bottom. Hide standard axis lines, use strictly dashed grid lines.

activity_feed.style: Dense list. Timestamps in monospace. Colors map to event severity.

data_table.style: Shadcn Table customized. border-collapse. Row hover is a stark background change, no soft fading.

live_indicator.style: A pulsing 6px by 6px circle next to the 'LIVE' text in the header. Color: #00FF66.

motion.hover_states: Crisp and instant. Background shifts slightly lighter, text brightens.
motion.chart_animations: Smooth linear transitions for data updates to simulate real-time stream.
motion.page_transitions: Minimalist fade. No heavy structural bouncing.

auth_background.description: Dark, moody abstract background for the login page hero section. Use with a heavy black overlay (bg-black/60) to keep the login form crisp.

brand_logo.description: Abstract geometric shape to be used as a logo placeholder in the sidebar or header.

testing.requirements: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. Do not inject default Tailwind blue or slate.
Install the following fonts from Google Fonts: Chivo, IBM Plex Sans, JetBrains Mono.
Build a custom auth page utilizing the auth_background image with a heavy overlay.
Implement the 'Control Room Grid' for the main dashboard (tight gaps, fully stretched cards).
Make sure the WebSockets live status has a pulsing green dot.
Do NOT use Card wrappers from Shadcn without stripping their default rounded-xl and shadows. We want sharp corners (rounded-sm maximum) and 1px borders.
